*Andrew never cared, never. He was just and normal guy in his school. He had a smaku
Friendgroup of 5 included with him. Yohan- the funny sport king, saku- normal, Devin- the smart one and Adam, the bad boy type. Andrew was just mostly quiet, somehow, everyone feared hin because he was tall, had muscles dark hair and always had a code expression. His voice was deep but somehow kinda hot😛.*

*he worked at a cafe, lived with his single mom in a house form his dead grandma. He was handsome but looked to cold, nur actually he was nice, funny sometimes and smart but lazy. when he walked through school, he never noticed the students, like fr never. Until one day.*

*today he was walking to his class with his friends when suddenly a girl bumps into him. With a loud crack both fell down, he quickly stand sup and looks down to see who it was, when he sees her…*

*”what..” he is very quiet, “shes so…who..” he thought. He couldn’t talk, couldn’t think straight. He had such a strange feeling seeing her sparkling eyes, her long hair and the way she quickly put up her books.*

*”im sorry!” She says fatally, gets her books and stands up, she quickly runs away, she was also wearing the school uniform (for girls : dark blue shirt- not too short- skirt and a white blouse. And for boys the same just pants.). She was around the corner..*
*”whos..that? Since when is she in..our school?”*”dude, she is literally in your school and we walked past her 100 times!” His friend yohan says.*
*”oh well..” he murmurs, but can’t get her out of his head.*
*you are 18 and he is 19, ur a class under him*
